briefdescription.para: Load LPD BISR data from an eFUSE tag and run the repair operation.

detaileddescription.para: Reads the tag size from the first word at EfuseTagAddr, clears the LPD BISR cache, copies the tag payload into the cache, and triggers repair. The function then waits for every required repair engine to finish and verifies that all required pass bits are set.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the tag header followed by its BISR payload.
Pointer updated with the post-copy BISR data cursor.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when all required repairs complete and pass; ERRSTS_REPAIR_BAD_TAG_SIZE when the payload exceeds 16 words; ERRSTS_REPAIR_TIMEOUT when completion polling times out; or ERRSTS_REPAIR_FUNCTION_FAILED when a required pass bit is clear.
Both pointers must be valid. Trigger and cache-register writes remain effective if a later completion or pass check fails.
